title: crataegus intermedia
intro: Crataegus intermedia, commonly known as Midwestern hawthorn, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including lowering blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus intermedia include acting as a vasodilator, improving heart function, and exerting antiarrhythmic and antihypertensive effects. The bioactive constituents of Crataegus intermedia include flavonoids, oligomeric proanthocyanidins, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
